title: staged shadow-buffer sparse allreduce and peer-aware launch throttling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Tensor-parallel workloads were experiencing periodic stalls when many concurrent in-flight microbatches attempted KV-cache merges at the same time. Motivation: Reduce communication tail-latency and improve overlap without changing model sharding. This PR introduces a two-part runtime optimization: (1) a staged 'shadow buffer' merge path that aggregates sparse KV merge deltas on-device and issues a single sparse-aware AllReduce, and (2) a peer-aware launch throttler that paces kernel/collective launches based on per-peer inflight credits and soft RTT estimates. Design: The shadow buffer acts as a small, per-GPU accumulator for kv-merge writebacks. When a microbatch finishes, the runtime appends a compact delta (indices + compressed values) into the shadow buffer. Periodically (configurable window), the kernel coalescer packs deltas and issues a sparse allreduce (custom op) that only transfers touched keys. The peer-aware throttler prevents an explosion of concurrent collectives by tracking recent completion latencies per peer (exponentially weighted) and computing a safe concurrency budget per GPU. The throttler operates at the scheduling layer so it also delays non-critical kernels (post-kv cleanup work) instead of blocking forward/backward compute. Compatibility: default behavior preserves existing dense fallback (unchanged merge path) when sparse mode is disabled or when sparsity falls below thresholds. The feature is gated behind two runtime knobs: TP_SHADOWBUF_ENABLE (default=true) and TP_SPARSE_ALLREDUCE_THRESHOLD (default=0.12). Benchmarks: On a 16xA100 TP run with realistic chat workloads, end-to-end latency p50 improved by 8% and p99 by 17% for long-context traffic; token throughput improved 6% while inter-GPU bandwidth usage dropped ~22% during peaks. On small sequences the overhead was neutral to slightly positive due to the throttler avoiding collectives bursts. Rollout: feature is enabled by default on dedicated clusters after a one-week canary. There are telemetry metrics added for shadowbuf_fill_rate, sparse_merge_ratio, peer_inflight_budget and throttled_kernel_count to detect regressions. Operator notes: migrations are non-breaking; however operators should validate that the sparse-allreduce builds for their NCCL/Collective stack. We added a diagnostic toggle to force dense fallback for debugging.
commits_summary: 6 commits: 1) runtime: add shadow buffer structures and buffer pool; 2) tp: implement sparse-delta serialization and packing; 3) collectives: sparse_allreduce op with optional compression; 4) scheduler: peer-aware launch throttler and inflight budget tracking; 5) telemetry: metrics and tracing for throttler + shadowbuf; 6) tests: microbench harness and CI gating for sparse op. Each commit is focused and accompanied by unit tests or microbench harnesses where applicable.
review_conversation: Marcus: Overall looks promising, but need clarity on memory safety for the shadow buffer when device OOM occurs. Aisha: added defensive checks and an eviction path that spills oldest deltas to host; updated docs. Sofia: can we quantify overhead of serialization? Aisha: added microbench that shows serialization adds ~120us per batch but is amortized by reduced network transfer. Olaf: edge case where a peer goes down mid-window — what happens to the inflight budget accounting? Aisha: throttler detects peer disconnects and instantly reclaims credits, also falls back to single-phase dense merge if peer set changes during packing; added unit test. Marcus: please add an opt-out env var for canaries. Aisha: done (TP_SHADOWBUF_ENABLE=false). Reviewers approved after two rounds; CI rerun after fixed race in packing code succeeded.

release_notes: Performance: Introduces staged shadow-buffer sparse allreduce — reduces inter-GPU bandwidth for sparse KV merges and improves p99 latency on TP workloads.
Runtime: Peer-aware launch throttler paces kernel and collective launches to avoid comm storms; can be tuned via runtime flags.
Ops: New telemetry (shadowbuf_fill_rate, sparse_merge_ratio, peer_inflight_budget) and a canary opt-out flag TP_SHADOWBUF_ENABLE.
